title: Grateful Dead Live at Freeborn Hall, University of California on 1971-01-21
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-DAC -> Wavelab v5 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Decent recording that captures a solid The Other One and Casey Jones but suffers from confusing track sequencing and an extra Casey Jones at the end.
ai_review.review: The show delivers strong performances of The Other One and Casey Jones, which reviewers highlight as the main attractions. However, listeners are distracted by apparent editing mistakes—a duplicate Casey Jones after the supposed finale and odd segues that scramble the set order—making the technical presentation only fair despite the musical strengths.

ai_rating.rationale: Two 4‑star reviews praise the music while one 3‑star note points out track‑order problems; overall show quality is good but recording issues lower the combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report an extra Casey Jones after the last track and confusing segues, indicating possible splicing or indexing errors; no comments on clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist appears out of order with Cosmic Charlie wrapped into The Other One segue, followed by China Cat Sunflower, I Know You Rider, and a reprise of Casey Jones; the sequencing confuses the listening experience.
